title: Chocolate-Blackberry Coffee Float
ldInstructionsRaw: Pour the chilled coffee into a glass and add the ice cream. Spoon on the blackberry purée, then top with whipped cream and nuts. Makes 1 serving (or 2 if you feel like sharing!).
For the whipped cream, whip a cup of heavy cream with a teaspoon of vanilla extract and a tablespoon of sugar until the cream forms a velvety, cloud-like texture.
